observation.visible_scene: The excerpt opens on a single interior cockpit frame (camouflaged arm raised against the windshield, blurred sky outside), then cuts to an exterior high-angle aerial view of a grey/camouflage military helicopter bearing a white medical cross, its upper fuselage burning and a thick dark smoke plume streaming from its rear. The helicopter moves across a manicured green lawn bordered by trees, a white colonnaded building, and a circular fountain. Throughout the exterior portion the aircraft is banked/tilted at varying angles, drifting and rotating relative to the ground while the on-board flames persist and the smoke trail continues.
visible_changes: Frame 1 is an interior cockpit shot; from frame 2 onward the view is an exterior aerial tracking shot, indicating an editing cut at the start rather than continuous motion.

The helicopter's attitude changes continuously: roughly level and low near the building (frames 2-14), then more steeply banked/angled over open lawn (frames 15-27), then nose-in toward the camera and lower over the lawn (frames 28-38).
A bright fireball/flame burst appears at the lower rear of the helicopter near the ground by the fountain in the final frames (39-41), larger than the earlier fuselage fire.
The white building is prominent early and moves out of frame as the camera follows the helicopter over the lawn; the fountain enters view at the left in later frames.
The dark smoke trail is present in every exterior frame, trailing to the right/behind the aircraft.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the helicopter's damage/fire is not shown.
The cockpit occupant's action and its relation to the exterior shot is not shown.
Whether the aircraft comes to rest, fully crashes, or recovers after the last frame is not shown.
uncertain_details: Exact camera motion (pan/orbit/dolly) is inferred from background shift and is not fully certain.
Whether the apparent change in altitude between the ground-level early frames and the airborne middle frames is continuous tumbling or a further shot boundary is ambiguous.
The fireball at the end could be an impact or a fuel flare; the clip shows the flare but not its trigger.
